payload.entry: Planning evidence before source edits: no prior-work notes or remaining-work handoff; choose tale/medium. Inspected 1311536, d8a828f and fetched c7a5f37 (cc.9); read CI logs 40225855522 and 40358201800. Per-test classification: (1) Design renderTabsLoaded expects old previous-tab morning_notes; current contract selects today_report. Hover fixture likewise must target a different open row while retaining XCTAssertNotEqual. (2) Tabs restore test query keep + papers filters out kept chat/small_reading before select, so its nil selection/90 offset failures are invalid fixture setup, not evidence to relax restore behavior. (3-4) Focus publish and reselection tests expose a product bug: inspectorLoader.$content emits in willSet, but tryFireHighlightsKeyFocus rereads inspectorLoader.content and sees old data; use the emitted map and test one-shot delivery. (5) TabSwitch test opens an ephemeral Highlights session then expects the next library show to stay in Tabs, contrary to 1311536 documented restore contract; split ordinary-Tabs consumption coverage from ephemeral restoration. (6) CurrentTab failure at 1311536 line 3125 is specifically currentID=nil while selected/preselected assertions passed; libraryDidPublish reconstructs RefsTabsListing without currentID, so preserve the field and force a refresh regression. c7a5f37 retains both product defects. cc coordination note records the Copy restore fixture issue and leaves Copy-specific changes to cc. epic-symbols currently reports no entries. BASELINE: every vault/metadata/overlay/scan event called publishRelationIndex(), which copied the records Map, rebuilt relationIndexTaskMemo() over every Tasks task, and walked all edges.

FIX: event-driven publishes now schedule one microtask rebuild via scheduleRelationIndexPublish(); api.relationIndex v1 reads (generation, ready, outgoing, incoming, labelSuggestions) and relationLabels.rows flush a pending publish so v1 never serves a stale snapshot; the Tasks task memo is reused until that turn ends.

TESTS: npm test 3777 pass; npm run validate pass. New coverage in scripts/test-ledger-tools-relation-index.cjs: 40 metadata events produce one publish, one memo build, and one onChange; a v1 read after an event flushes the pending rebuild without waiting for the microtask.

COST: synthetic 40-file index — uncoalesced apply+flush 27.6ms, coalesced event-stack 0.58ms + turn 1.43ms. Vault copy (6725 md, 3223 prefiltered, 250 synthetic relations) — uncoalesced storm 196.96ms vs coalesced 140.79ms (40 parses of a 293KB daily plus one publish).

DEPLOY: rebased onto origin/master 5790364, rebuilt, bob plugins sync --no-pull -p bob-ledger-tools from this checkout; copied main.js.

LIMITATIONS: bob-cli-a5 left open for the lander. Distinct async turns (scan chunks, target-read promises) still publish separately. Live Obsidian renderer cost was not measured in-app.

DECISIONS: theme_field_strip and legacy_key do not apply to this phase.

Coalesced event-driven relation-index publishes to one microtask rebuild with same-turn task-memo reuse; v1 reads flush pending state. JS freshnessStampLine / freshnessKeepLine / freshnessSetRefreshLine via freshnessIsPomodoroLedgerLine. - Delegation: cycler 010-core.js applyFreshStampLine; nav 470-keydown-and-freshness.js applyFreshStampLine / applyFreshRefreshLine (line-only plus optional ## Pomodoros section context); block-id-prompt 030-tasks-and-dependencies.js applyFreshStampLine. Injected/older stampers cannot stamp a recognizable ledger body.
- Context-aware: cycler 180/190 isPomodoroLedgerLineInEditor / InSourceText using findPomodorosSectionInLines + isPomodoroTaskLine (covers local, Tasks-command follow-up, fallback rewrite, and legacy headings). Nav callers pass {content, line} into the shared writer (blocks stage, counted batches, lane/link commit, freshness refresh, decay keep/classifyRottenKeepTarget, project subtree, schedule, task-move, etc.).
